title: Answer-Only Disclosure: Private-Context LLM Assistance over Web APIs with a Leakage Ledger
abstract: arXiv:2610.38126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web assistants increasingly answer questions about a user's private documents by pairing a small on-device model with a cloud LLM behind a Web API. In collaborative decoding, the document stays on the client, and the cloud receives only a public view that the user approves, such as the question alone, but the two models exchange messages while the answer is generated. We show that the message transcript can disclose private content that neither the public view nor the answer contains. In a planted-secret audit, speculative decoding with private drafts did not include the secret code in its answers, yet sent the code to the cloud in rejected drafts. We present ADLER, a decoding protocol for streaming LLM APIs in which every message to the cloud depends only on the public view and the answer the user sees, regardless of how the client combines the two models or how the cloud behaves. translated_title: 仅答案披露：基于Web API的私有上下文大语言模型辅助与泄漏账本
translated_abstract: Web助手越来越多地通过将小型设备端模型与Web API背后的云端大语言模型配对，来回答有关用户私有文档的问题。在协作解码过程中，文档保留在客户端，云端仅接收用户批准的公共视图（例如仅问题本身），但两个模型在生成答案时会交换消息。我们证明，这些消息记录可能泄露公共视图和答案中都不包含的私有内容。在一项植入机密的审计中，使用私有草稿的投机解码虽然在答案中没有包含机密代码，却在被拒绝的草稿中将代码发送到了云端。我们提出了ADLER，这是一种面向流式LLM API的解码协议，其中发送到云端的每条消息仅取决于公共视图和用户看到的答案，而与客户端如何组合两个模型或云端的行为方式无关。随后，客户端泄漏账本可对（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了云端协作解码中的消息记录会在用户不知情的情况下泄露私有文档内容（例如被拒绝的投机解码草稿中包含机密代码），并提出ADLER解码协议与客户端泄漏账本，确保发送到云端的每条消息仅依赖于公共视图和用户可见的答案，从而堵住这一隐私泄露通道。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that message transcripts in cloud-device collaborative decoding can leak private document content without the user's knowledge (e.g., rejected speculative decoding drafts containing secret codes), and proposes ADLER, a decoding protocol with a client-side leakage ledger that ensures every message sent to the cloud depends only on the public view and the user-visible answer, closing this privacy leakage channel.
